
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/test-shirley/p/22911145" title="发布于 2026-09-09 19:44">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">知识图谱部署</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div id="header" class="header doc-head doc-head-doc doc-type-head ViewerHeader-module_wrapper_idlWC undefined" data-header-mode="title" data-aspm="c36321">
<div class="doc-head-inner">
<div class="header-action">
<div class="ViewerHeader-module_offlineButton_Wl3rP">
<div class="ViewerHeader-module_copyMarkdown_L69KR">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u84b72a46" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">已经有完整的weknora部署指南，现在在已有部署基础上添加neo4j配置。</span></p>
<p id="ueb3ae8fe" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">WeKnora 的知识图谱功能可以不部署 Neo4j 也能启用</span><span class="ne-text">，但功能会有限制。</span></p>
<p id="u6eebfa51" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Neo4j 在 WeKnora 中是一个</span><strong><span class="ne-text">可选组件</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，主要作用是为知识图谱提供持久化存储和查询能力。即使没有 Neo4j，你仍然可以使用知识图谱功能，只是无法获得完整的 GraphRAG（基于知识图谱的检索增强生成）体验。</span></p>
<h2 id="LzwCo"><span class="ne-text">不部署 Neo4j 时，知识图谱能做什么？</span></h2>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u37542472" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">实体和关系提取</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：系统仍然可以分析文档，自动提取其中的实体（如人物、地点、概念）和它们之间的关系</span><span class="ne-text">。</span></li>
<li id="uabdcf7be" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">Wiki 模式下的交互式图谱</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：在“Wiki 模式”下，Agent 可以将原始文档整理成交互式知识图谱，即使没有 Neo4j 作为后端，这个功能依然可用</span><span class="ne-text">。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="An8Af"><span class="ne-text">❌</span><span class="ne-text"> 不部署 Neo4j 时，知识图谱不能做什么？</span></h2>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u4505c017" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">GraphRAG 增强检索</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：这是知识图谱最核心的用途之一。没有 Neo4j，系统就无法在进行检索时，利用知识图谱中实体间的关联关系来找到更全面、更相关的上下文信息</span><span class="ne-text">。</span></li>
<li id="ucd987c5f" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">图谱数据的持久化与可视化查询</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：你无法通过 Neo4j 的浏览器界面（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">http://localhost:7474</span></code><span class="ne-text">）来直观地查看、管理和查询构建好的知识图谱。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="YbwL1"><span class="ne-text">⚙️</span><span class="ne-text"> 如何配置？</span></h2>
<h3 id="65584877"><span class="ne-text">前置检查</span></h3>
<p id="u2c658434" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">确保您当前在 WeKnora 项目目录下（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">cd WeKnora</span></code><span class="ne-text">），且 Docker 服务正常运行。</span></p>
<hr id="YeUy2" class="ne-hr">
<h3 id="6bec4662"><span class="ne-text">第一步：修改</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">.env</span></code> <span class="ne-text">文件，添加 Neo4j 配置</span></h3>
<p id="u849044d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在项目根目录下，使用 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">vi .env</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 或 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">sed</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 命令添加以下 Neo4j 配置项（如果已有则修改）：</span></p>
<pre id="LrGjB" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code># 追加到 .env 末尾
cat &gt;&gt; .env &lt;&lt; 'EOF'
NEO4J_ENABLE=true
NEO4J_URI=bolt://neo4j:7687
NEO4J_USERNAME=neo4j
NEO4J_PASSWORD=your_strong_password_here
EOF</code></pre>
<p id="u319c0a31" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">请将</span></strong><strong> </strong><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">your_strong_password_here</span></strong></code><strong> </strong><strong><span class="ne-text">替换为您自己的强密码（例如</span></strong><strong> </strong><code class="ne-code"><strong><span class="ne-text">WeKnora2025!</span></strong></code><strong><span class="ne-text">）</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，并记住此密码。</span></p>
<p id="uec5bed13" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">注意</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">DB_*</span></code> <span class="ne-text">配置保持不变，</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">NEO4J_*</span></code> <span class="ne-text">是新增的，不会影响现有 PostgreSQL 数据库。</span></p>
<hr id="odR5j" class="ne-hr">
<h3 id="8d2878dc"><span class="ne-text">第二步：修改</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker-compose.yml</span></code><span class="ne-text">，添加 Neo4j 服务</span></h3>
<p id="u50a29cf9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">WeKnora 的</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker-compose.yml</span></code> <span class="ne-text">可能已包含 Neo4j 服务（但被注释或需要 profile）。您需要编辑该文件，确保 Neo4j 服务被启用。</span></p>
<p id="u20ee1e07" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">打开</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">docker-compose.yml</span></code><span class="ne-text">：</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u4bf85536" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">vi docker-compose.yml</span></li>
<li id="u0fe40538" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">查找 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">neo4j</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 服务定义。如果存在但被 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">profiles</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 限制，请移除或修改该限制。通常该服务定义如下（若无，请将以下内容添加到 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">services</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 部分）：</span></li>
</ol>
<pre id="YbX2l" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>neo4j:
    image: neo4j:5.22.0
    container_name: weknora-neo4j
    ports:
      - "7474:7474"   # HTTP 管理界面
      - "7687:7687"   # Bolt 协议端口
    environment:
      - NEO4J_AUTH=${NEO4J_USERNAME}/${NEO4J_PASSWORD}
      - NEO4J_PLUGINS=["apoc"]
    volumes:
      - neo4j-data:/data
      - neo4j-logs:/logs
    networks:
      - weknora-network
    restart: unless-stopped
    # 如果原有的 services 中有 profiles，请删除或注释掉</code></pre>
<p id="u9da923d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">同时，在文件末尾的 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">volumes</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 部分添加：</span></p>
<pre id="qhs4d" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>volumes:
  neo4j-data:
  neo4j-logs:</code></pre>
<p id="u5e46db31" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">网络部分（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">networks</span></code><span class="ne-text">）应已存在</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">weknora-network</span></code><span class="ne-text">，无需修改。</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="3">
<li id="u9bb947b1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">保存并退出。</span></li>
</ol>
<hr id="cCzpR" class="ne-hr">
<h3 id="5fb939f1"><span class="ne-text">第三步：重启服务并启动 Neo4j</span></h3>
<p id="u429eeb5d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用 Docker Compose 重新启动所有服务（包括新加入的 Neo4j）：</span></p>
<pre id="TnP0g" class="ne-codeblock language-plain highlighter-hljs" data-language="plain"><code>docker compose down   # 可选，如果不希望中断现有服务，也可以直接 up
docker compose up -d</code></pre>
<p id="ue1903d03" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看所有容器状态：</span></p>
<p id="u5b10a361" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">docker compose ps</span></p>
<p id="uc29708e4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">您应该能看到名为</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">weknora-neo4j</span></code> <span class="ne-text">的容器状态为</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Up</span></code><span class="ne-text">。</span></p>
<hr id="k4b3s" class="ne-hr">
<h3 id="248d5d25"><span class="ne-text">第四步：验证 Neo4j 是否正常运行</span></h3>
<p id="u52d2a49a" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">查看 Neo4j 日志</span></strong><span class="ne-text">（确认无报错）：</span></p>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u5bf2273f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">docker compose logs neo4j --tail=50</span></li>
<li id="udb1ea2d6" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">访问 Neo4j 浏览器</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：在浏览器中打开 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">http://您的服务器公网IP:7474</span></code><span class="ne-text">，使用您在 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">.env</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 中设置的用户名（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">neo4j</span></code><span class="ne-text">）和密码登录。如果能够登录，则 Neo4j 已正常运行。</span></li>
<li id="ue67ee588" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">若无法成功，可能因为没有</span><strong><span class="ne-text">设置安全组</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></li>
<li id="ua87532fa" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">docker compose logs app | grep -i neo4j</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="uc241dbc8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果出现类似</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Neo4j driver initialized successfully</span></code> <span class="ne-text">或</span> <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">GraphRAG enabled</span></code> <span class="ne-text">的信息，则表示连接成功。</span></p>
<h4 id="uVwWp"><span class="ne-text">设置安全组</span></h4>
<p id="ucd1d34e7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果希望从外部访问 Neo4j 浏览器（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">7474</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 端口），请在腾讯云安全组中放行该端口。若不需外部访问，可跳过此步。</span></p>
<p id="ub5558cfa" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">确认 WeKnora 能连接 Neo4j</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：查看 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">app</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 容器的日志，看是否有成功连接 Neo4j 的信息：</span></p>
<hr id="MUgRS" class="ne-hr">
<h3 id="4523c96e"><span class="ne-text">第五步：在 WeKnora Web 界面启用知识图谱</span></h3>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="uc3ecc5e1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">登录 WeKnora Web 界面（</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">http://您的服务器公网IP:8081</span></code><span class="ne-text">）。</span></li>
<li id="u20b36fb9" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">进入某个</span><strong><span class="ne-text">知识库</span></strong><span class="ne-text">的设置页面（或全局设置）。</span></li>
<li id="u49042df0" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">找到</span> <strong><span class="ne-text">“知识图谱”</span></strong> <span class="ne-text">或</span> <strong><span class="ne-text">“实体和关系抽取”</span></strong> <span class="ne-text">选项，将其</span><strong><span class="ne-text">启用</span></strong><span class="ne-text">。</span></li>
<li id="u5fe09cd4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">根据需要调整抽取强度等参数（默认即可）。</span></li>
<li id="uf61a57c0" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">保存设置。</span></li>
</ol>
<hr id="RGd01" class="ne-hr">
<h3 id="ea18c84f"><span class="ne-text">第六步：上传文档，自动构建知识图谱</span></h3>
<p id="u99577db1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">向该知识库上传文档（支持 PDF、Word、Markdown 等），WeKnora 会在后台自动进行实体和关系抽取，并存入 Neo4j。</span></p>
<p id="u271ad6bf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">可以重新构建已上传文档，WeKnora 会在后台自动进行实体和关系抽取，并存入 Neo4j。</span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
